saw.text: Root-zone soil moisture across the district falls below the 20th percentile and stays there into 2022.

chapters.title: May 2022: the check is left bare

saw.text: No flood-up and no green-up. The field reads as bare soil for almost the whole year.

reported: Calif. rice acreage to drop to 39-year low
A Rough Year for Rice in California

chapters.title: January 2023: the storms arrive

saw.text: Ten-day rain totals jump to the top of the record and the bare field turns to open water.

reported: Atmospheric-river storms, Jan–Mar 2023 (headline to be cached)

chapters.title: June 2023: planting runs late

saw.text: Green-up arrives later than in the years before the drought; harvest slides toward the autumn rain.

reported: Later rice harvest deals minor yield, quality impacts

caf_tulare_forage.title: Pumping, a lake, then probation: 2022 to 2024

saw.text: Groundwater storage for the basin sits at the bottom of the record shown here.

chapters.title: Spring 2023: the lake comes back

saw.text: Open water appears across the low side of the field and stays for weeks.

reported: Dormant California lake reappeared and isn’t going anywhere fast

chapters.title: April 2024: the basin goes on probation

saw.text: One wet year refilled the soil, but groundwater storage recovered only part of the way.

reported: State Water Board places Tulare Lake Subbasin on probation
